<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style data-sonjari-theme="editorial-forest">/* sonjari-template */

  :root {
    --green: #2e4a2a;
    --green-deep: #243a21;
    --green-lite: #3a5a36;
    --pink: #e89cb1;
    --pink-deep: #d27e96;
    --cream: #efe7d4;
    --cream-2: #e6dcc4;
    --ink: #1a1a17;
    --serif: Georgia, 'Batang', serif;
    --mono: Consolas, 'Malgun Gothic', monospace;
  }
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #111; }
  

  section {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 1280px;
    height: 720px;
    padding: 64px 80px;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--ink);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .label {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ============ 01 — Cover ============ */
  .cover {
    background: var(--green);
    color: var(--pink);
    padding: 66.67px 93.33px;
  }
  .cover .topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    color: var(--pink);
  }
  .cover .topbar .label { color: var(--pink); }
  .cover .mark {
    width: 86.67px;
    height: 86.67px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.33px solid var(--pink);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 18.67px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .cover h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 146.67px;
    line-height: 0.92;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin: 26.67px 0 0 0;
  }
  .cover .footline {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 53.33px;
    left: 93.33px;
    right: 93.33px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 18.67px;
    color: var(--pink);
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ============ 02 — Agenda (tiles) ============ */
  .agenda {
    background: var(--cream);
    padding: 60px 80px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
    gap: 24px;
  }
  .agenda .head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 26.67px;
  }
  .agenda h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 64px;
    line-height: 0.96;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--green);
    margin: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .agenda .head .label { color: var(--green); white-space: nowrap; }
  .agenda-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .topic {
    border-radius: 4px;
    position: relative;
    padding: 26.67px 26.67px 24px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .topic.t-green { background: var(--green); color: var(--pink); grid-row: span 2; }
  .topic.t-pink { background: var(--pink); color: var(--green-deep); }
  .topic.t-greenLite { background: var(--green-lite); color: var(--pink); }
  .topic.t-cream { background: var(--cream-2); color: var(--green); border: 1.33px solid var(--green); }
  .topic .num {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .topic h3 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 37.33px;
    line-height: 0.98;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin: 18.67px 0 0 0;
  }
  .topic.t-green h3 { font-size: 56px; }
  .topic p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    line-height: 1.32;
    margin: 10.67px 0 0 0;
    max-width: 100%;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .topic .foot {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-top: 13.33px;
  }

  /* ============ 03 — Statement (big idea) ============ */
  .statement {
    background: var(--pink);
    color: var(--green-deep);
    padding: 86.67px 106.67px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .statement .label { color: var(--green-deep); }
  .statement blockquote {
    margin: 32px 0 0 0;
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 93.33px;
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    max-width: 1040px;
  }
  .statement .attrib {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
    margin-top: 40px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    font-weight: 500;
    gap: 40px;
  }
  .statement .attrib > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9.33px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .statement .attrib .name {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 29.33px;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  /* ============ 04 — Two-column with image ============ */
  .two-col {
    background: var(--cream);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 586.67px 1fr;
    gap: 66.67px;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 73.33px 80px;
  }
  .two-col .col-img {
    background: var(--green);
    color: var(--pink);
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .two-col .col-img .figure {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 37.33px;
    color: var(--pink);
    font-weight: 500;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0 26.67px;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }
  .two-col .col-img .caption {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 24px;
    left: 24px;
    right: 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--pink);
  }
  .two-col .col-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: 5.33px; }
  .two-col .eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--green);
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 21.33px;
  }
  .two-col h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 64px;
    line-height: 0.96;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--green);
    margin: 0 0 26.67px 0;
  }
  .two-col p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 1.38;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0 0 16px 0;
    max-width: 506.67px;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  .two-col .meta {
    margin-top: auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    border-top: 1.33px solid var(--green);
    padding-top: 21.33px;
  }
  .two-col .meta dt {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--green);
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 5.33px;
  }
  .two-col .meta dd {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 21.33px;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ============ 05 — Data / chart ============ */
  .data { background: var(--green); color: var(--cream); padding: 66.67px 80px; }
  .data .head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 40px;
  }
  .data .head .label { color: var(--pink); }
  .data h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 56px;
    line-height: 1.0;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--cream);
    margin: 10.67px 0 0 0;
    max-width: 800px;
  }
  .data .legend {
    display: flex;
    gap: 24px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--cream);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .data .legend .sw {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 17.33px;
    height: 17.33px;
    margin-right: 8px;
    vertical-align: -2.67px;
    border-radius: 1.33px;
  }
  .chart {
    margin-top: 73.33px;
    height: 346.67px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 53.33px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr 40px;
    column-gap: 16px;
  }
  .chart .yaxis {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    color: var(--cream);
    text-align: right;
    padding-right: 5.33px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .chart .plot {
    position: relative;
    border-left: 1.33px solid var(--cream);
    border-bottom: 1.33px solid var(--cream);
    padding: 0 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .chart .grid-lines {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to top, transparent 0 calc(25% - 1px), rgba(239,231,212,0.18) calc(25% - 1px) 25%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .bar-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; flex: 1; height: 100%; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 5.33px; }
  .bar-pair { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; height: 100%; width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  .bar { width: 37.33px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; position: relative; }
  .bar.a { background: var(--pink); }
  .bar.b { background: var(--cream); }
  .bar .val {
    position: absolute;
    top: -25.33px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--cream);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .chart .xlabel-row {
    grid-column: 2;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 20px 0;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    color: var(--cream);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .chart .xlabel { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
  .data .footnote {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 40px;
    left: 80px;
    right: 80px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    color: var(--pink);
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ============ 06 — Framework / 4 steps ============ */
  .framework { background: var(--cream); padding: 66.67px 80px; }
  .framework .head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 26.67px;
  }
  .framework .head .label { color: var(--green); white-space: nowrap; }
  .framework h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 64px;
    line-height: 0.96;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--green);
    margin: 16px 0 0 0;
    max-width: 1000px;
  }
  .flow {
    margin-top: 46.67px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 18.67px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .step {
    border-radius: 5.33px;
    padding: 26.67px 21.33px 21.33px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 313.33px;
    border: 1.67px solid var(--green);
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--green);
  }
  .step.fill { background: var(--green); color: var(--pink); border-color: var(--green); }
  .step.pinkfill { background: var(--pink); color: var(--green-deep); border-color: var(--pink-deep); }
  .step .num {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .step h3 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 45.33px;
    line-height: 0.96;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin: 16px 0 16px 0;
  }
  .step p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    line-height: 1.34;
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .step .marker {
    margin-top: auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1.33px solid currentColor;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ============ 07 — Big stats / KPI callouts ============ */
  .stats { background: var(--green); color: var(--cream); padding: 66.67px 80px; }
  .stats .head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 26.67px;
  }
  .stats .head .label { color: var(--pink); white-space: nowrap; }
  .stats h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 53.33px;
    line-height: 0.98;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--cream);
    margin: 12px 0 0 0;
    max-width: 933.33px;
  }
  .kpi-row {
    margin-top: 53.33px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 40px;
    border-top: 1.33px solid var(--pink);
    padding-top: 37.33px;
  }
  .kpi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10.67px; }
  .kpi .tag {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--pink);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .kpi .big {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 146.67px;
    line-height: 0.92;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    color: var(--pink);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .kpi .big .unit {
    font-size: 73.33px;
    color: var(--cream);
    margin-left: 2.67px;
  }
  .kpi .desc {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 1.32;
    color: var(--cream);
    margin: 5.33px 0 0 0;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* ============ 08 — Summary / closing ============ */
  .summary { background: var(--green); color: var(--cream); padding: 73.33px 93.33px; }
  .summary .topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .summary .topbar .label { color: var(--pink); }
  .summary h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 146.67px;
    line-height: 0.94;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--pink);
    margin: 33.33px 0 0 0;
  }
  .summary .grid-cols {
    margin-top: 46.67px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 40px;
    border-top: 1.33px solid var(--pink);
    padding-top: 24px;
  }
  .summary .grid-cols h4 {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 17.33px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--pink);
    margin: 0 0 12px 0;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .summary .grid-cols p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 21.33px;
    line-height: 1.32;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--cream);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

/* 표지 · 마무리 부품 (2026-10-26 대표 「템플릿은 참고만 — 글자 · 간격 · 줄 · 도형까지 손자리가 짓는다」).
   템플릿 표지를 통째로 베끼지 않는다. 글(머리 말 · 큰 제목 · 부제 · 이름:값 · 날짜/출처 · 쪽)은 **위에서 아래로 흐르는 한 줄기**에만 놓는다 —
   절대 위치 글이 없으니 글끼리 겹칠 수 없다(10-26 c81a10dd 표지: 긴 꼬리말이 작은 바닥 글과 겹쳤다).
   장식(.pz-deco)은 코드가 결 값으로 그리는 도형이고, 글 줄기가 비켜 가는 자리(padding)에만 놓인다.
   값은 slide_frames.frame_css 가 --pz-* 로 끼운다. 이 파일은 혼자 선다(IR 처럼 부품 묶음 CSS 가 없는 결도 쓴다). */
section.slide.pz-frame {
  width: 1280px; height: 720px; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; inset: auto; overflow: hidden; margin: 0;
  opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: none; pointer-events: auto; isolation: isolate;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; justify-content: flex-start;
  padding: 56px 72px 40px; background: var(--fr-bg); color: var(--fr-ink); font-family: var(--pz-font);
  text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -0.2px; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: break-word;
  --fr-bg: var(--pz-bg); --fr-ink: var(--pz-ink); --fr-sub: var(--pz-sub); --fr-faint: var(--pz-faint); --fr-line: var(--pz-line);
  --fr-key: var(--pz-key); --fr-head: var(--pz-head-color);
  --fd-a: var(--pz-accent); --fd-b: var(--pz-key); --fd-c: var(--pz-hi); --fd-d: var(--pz-c2, var(--pz-accent)); --fd-e: var(--pz-c3, var(--pz-key));
  --fd-f: var(--pz-c4, var(--pz-hi)); --fd-line: var(--pz-line-strong);
}
section.slide.pz-frame * { box-sizing: border-box; }
section.slide.pz-frame::before, section.slide.pz-frame::after { content: none; }
/* 마무리는 색 면으로 뒤집는다 — 표지와 같은 짜임, 다른 바탕(장표의 끝을 알린다). */
section.slide.pz-frame.fr-closing {
  --fr-bg: var(--pz-accent); --fr-ink: var(--pz-on-accent); --fr-sub: var(--pz-on-accent-sub); --fr-faint: var(--pz-on-accent-sub);
  --fr-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pz-on-accent) 28%, transparent); --fr-key: var(--pz-on-accent); --fr-head: var(--pz-on-accent);

<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style data-sonjari-theme="emerald-editorial">/* sonjari-template */

  :root {
    --bg: #3CD896;
    --bg-2: #2DC684;
    --bg-3: #25B377;
    --ink: #0F1A5C;
    --ink-2: #1B2774;
    --ink-3: #3A4593;
    --paper: #F1E9D6;
    --rule: rgba(15, 26, 92, 0.22);
    --rule-strong: rgba(15, 26, 92, 0.85);
    --display-font: Georgia, 'Batang', serif;
  }

  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #0a0a0a; }
  

  section.slide {
    width: 1280px;
    height: 720px;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    box-sizing: border-box;

  /* Bold display serif — Bodoni Moda heavy */
  .display {
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-style: normal;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    line-height: 0.95;
  }
  .display-md {
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-style: normal;
  }

  .sans {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .sans-b {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* Double-rule decorative ornament — the signature treatment */
  .ornament {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 17.33px;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .ornament .word {
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.42em;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    padding: 0 2.67px;
  }
  .ornament .lines {
    flex: 1;
    height: 12px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .ornament .lines::before,
  .ornament .lines::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 2.67px;
    background: var(--ink);
  }
  .ornament .lines::before { top: 2px; }
  .ornament .lines::after { bottom: 2px; }

  /* Side double-rule for small inline words */
  .of-mark {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14.67px;
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .of-mark::before, .of-mark::after {
    content: "";
    width: 42.67px;
    height: 12px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(var(--ink), var(--ink)) 0 2.67px / 100% 2.67px no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(var(--ink), var(--ink)) 0 8px / 100% 2.67px no-repeat;
  }

  /* Shared masthead / footline */
  .masthead {
    position: absolute;
    top: 37.33px;
    left: 53.33px;
    right: 53.33px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 17.33px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--ink);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .footline {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 37.33px;
    left: 53.33px;
    right: 53.33px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 17.33px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .rule-h { height: 2.67px; background: var(--ink); }

  /* ============== SLIDE 1 — COVER ============== */
  .s1 {
    padding: 37.33px 73.33px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .s1-top {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 17.33px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .s1-stage {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2.67px;
    padding: 6.67px 0;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .s1-line { color: var(--ink); }
  .s1-the { font-family: var(--display-font); font-weight: 800; font-size: 50.67px; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: -1.33px; }
  .s1-big {
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 122.67px;
    line-height: 0.92;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .s1-mid {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    gap: 21.33px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 933.33px;
  }
  .s1-mid .rule {
    flex: 1; height: 14.67px; position: relative;
  }
  .s1-mid .rule::before, .s1-mid .rule::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3.33px; background: var(--ink);

  .s1-mid .rule::before { top: 1.33px; }
  .s1-mid .rule::after { bottom: 1.33px; }
  .s1-mid .of {
    font-family: var(--display-font); font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 45.33px; line-height: 1; padding: 0 4px;

  /* Ornament rule variants — controlled by :root[data-ornament] */
  :root[data-ornament="single"] .s1-mid .rule::before,

  .s1-credit {
    margin-top: 20px;

    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 18.67px;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;

  /* ============== SLIDE 2 — AGENDA ============== */
  .s2 {
    padding: 73.33px 73.33px 46.67px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }

  .s2-title {
    font-family: var(--display-font);

    line-height: 1;
  }
  .s2-row .name {
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 42.67px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  .s2-row .kind {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 17.33px;

  /* ============== SLIDE 3 — SECTION OPENER ============== */

    padding: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .s3-left {
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--bg);

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

  }

  }
  .s3-numeral {
    font-family: var(--display-font);

    font-size: 306.67px;
    line-height: 0.9;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;

  }

/* 장표 배치 뼈대 — 모든 결이 같이 쓴다 (2026-10-25).
 * 1280×720 한 장. 글자 크기는 전부 em(장 기본 20px) — 넘치면 굽기 전에 장 기본 크기 하나만 줄여 맞춘다(slides.FIT_JS).
 * 색 · 글꼴 · 면은 결 파일이 정한다. 여기는 자리 · 크기 · 간격만.
 * 배치 문법(큰 색 면 · 크기 다른 칸 · 가는 선 · 아주 큰 숫자)은 beautiful-html-templates(MIT · Zara Zhang)를 보고 우리 말로 새로 썼다.
 */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 1280px; height: 720px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper); }
body { font-family: var(--sans); color: var(--ink); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
section {
  position: relative; width: 1280px; height: 720px; overflow: hidden;
  padding: 64px 76px 70px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.5;
  background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink);
  word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: break-word;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
h1, h2, h3, p, ul, ol, blockquote, table, figure { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
ul, ol { list-style: none; }
b, strong { font-weight: 700; }
h1, h2, h3, blockquote { text-wrap: balance; }

/* 공통 글자 사다리 — 꼬리말 0.8 · 본문 1 · 소제목 1.4 · 장 제목 2.6 · 표지 5 · 주인공 숫자 9 */
.kicker { font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--accent-text); margin-bottom: 14px; }
h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: var(--display-weight); font-size: 2.6em; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--title); max-width: 1000px; }
h3 { font-size: 1.3em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.lede { font-size: 1.15em; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 760px; }
.note { font-size: 0.75em; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-top: auto; padding-top: 14px; }
em.hi, .hi { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-text); }

/* 쪽 표시 — 굽기 전에 우리가 넣는다(모델은 쓰지 않는다) */
.folio { position: absolute; left: 76px; right: 76px; bottom: 26px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--folio, var(--ink-faint)); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

/* ── 1. 표지 cover ─────────────────────────────── */
section.cover { justify-content: flex-end; padding-bottom: 88px; }
.cover h1 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: var(--display-weight); font-size: 5em; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.035em; max-width: 1050px; color: var(--title); }
.cover .lede { margin-top: 26px; }
.cover .meta { display: flex; gap: 56px; margin-top: 44px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 2px solid var(--rule-strong); }
.meta > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.meta b { font-size: 1.1em; }
.meta span { font-size: 0.75em; color: var(--ink-faint); }

/* ── 2. 장 넘김 section ─────────────────────────── */
section.section { flex-direction: row; align-items: stretch; padding: 0; }
.section .big { width: 46%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: var(--display-weight);
  font-size: 13em; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em; background: var(--field); color: var(--field-ink); }
.section .side { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px 76px; }
.section .side h2 { font-size: 3em; }
.section .side .lede { margin-top: 22px; }

/* ── 3. 한 문장 statement ───────────────────────── */
section.statement { justify-content: center; padding: 80px 110px; }
.statement blockquote { font-family: var(--quote); font-weight: var(--quote-weight); font-size: 3.6em; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.02em; max-width: 1040px; }
.statement .by { margin-top: 34px; font-size: 0.9em; opacity: 0.8; }

/* ── 4. 큰 숫자 bignum ─────────────────────────── */
section.bignum h2 { font-size: 2.2em; max-width: 900px; }
.bignum .hero { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 48px; }
.bignum .num { font-family: var(--figure); font-weight: var(--figure-weight); font-size: 10em; line-height: 0.86; letter-spacing: -0.05em; color: var(--accent-text); white-space: nowrap; }
.bignum .num small { font-size: 0.3em; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 8px; }
.bignum .was { font-family: var(--figure); font-size: 3.4em; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink-faint); white-space: nowrap; padding-bottom: 14px; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; }
.bignum .desc { max-width: 380px; font-size: 1.05em; color: var(--ink-soft); padding-bottom: 14px; }

/* ── 5. 숫자 띠 stats ─────────────────────────── */
.stats .row { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); margin-top: auto; border-top: 2px solid var(--rule-strong); }
.stat { padding: 30px 28px 6px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); margin-right: 28px; }
.stat:last-child { border-right: 0; margin-right: 0; }
.stat .v { font-family: var(--figure); font-weight: var(--figure-weight); font-size: 6.4em; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.035em; white-space: nowrap; }
.stat .k { margin-top: 18px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15em; }
.stat .d { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.95em; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.stat.on .v { color: var(--accent-text); }

/* ── 6. 맞대기 compare ─────────────────────────── */
.compare .cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; margin-top: auto; min-height: 360px; }
.compare .col { padding: 32px 36px 36px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; }
.compare .col.on { background: var(--field); color: var(--field-ink); }
.compare .col h3 { font-size: 2.1em; line-height: 1.2; }
.compare ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.compare li { position: relative; padding-left: 24px; font-size: 1.2em; line-height: 1.45; }
.compare li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.62em; width: 10px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.7; }

/* ── 7. 흐름 steps ─────────────────────────────── */
.steps ol { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; margin-top: auto; counter-reset: step; }
.steps li { counter-increment: step; position: relative; padding: 0 26px 0 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.steps li::before { content: counter(step); font-family: var(--figure); font-weight: var(--figure-weight); font-size: 6em; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--accent-text); padding-bottom: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--rule-strong); }
.steps li.on::before { color: var(--field-ink); background: var(--field); padding: 16px 18px 20px; margin: -16px 8px 10px -18px; border-bottom-color: transparent; }
.steps li b { font-size: 1.4em; line-height: 1.3; }
.steps li span { font-size: 1em; color: var(--ink-soft); min-height: 4.5em; }

/* ── 8. 막대 bars ─────────────────────────────── */
.bars .chart { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; margin-top: 26px; }
.bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 230px 1fr 150px; align-items: center; gap: 22px; }
.bar .name { font-weight: 700; text-align: right; line-height: 1.25; }
.bar .name small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.72em; color: var(--ink-faint); }
.bar i { display: block; height: 40px; background: var(--track); position: relative; }
.bar i::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: var(--v, 50%); min-width: 4px; background: var(--bar); }
.bar.on i::after { background: var(--accent); }
.bar .val { font-family: var(--figure); font-weight: var(--figure-weight); font-size: 1.6em; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; }
.bar.on .val { color: var(--accent-text); }

/* ── 9. 표 table ─────────────────────────────── */
.table table { margin: auto 0; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 1.12em; }
.table th { text-align: left; font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 700; padding: 14px 20px; background: var(--field); color: var(--field-ink); }
.table td { padding: 20px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); line-height: 1.35; }
.table tr.on td { background: var(--surface); font-weight: 700; }
.table td:first-child { font-weight: 700; }

/* ── 10. 반반 split ─────────────────────────────── */
section.split { flex-direction: row; padding: 0; }
.split .lead { width: 42%; padding: 64px 52px 70px 76px; background: var(--field); color: var(--field-ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; }
.split .lead .kicker { color: var(--field-kicker); }
.split .lead h2 { color: var(--field-ink); font-size: 2.7em; }
.split .body { flex: 1; padding: 64px 76px 70px 56px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 22px; }
.split .body li { padding: 20px 0; font-size: 1.08em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); line-height: 1.5; }
.split .body li:first-child { border-top: 2px solid var(--rule-strong); }
.split .body li b { display: block; font-size: 1.3em; margin-bottom: 4px; }

/* ── 11. 크기 다른 칸 tiles ─────────────────────── */
.tiles .grid { flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.45fr 1fr 1fr; grid-auto-rows: 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-top: 28px; }
.tile { padding: 24px 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); min-height: 0; }
.tile b { font-size: 1.3em; line-height: 1.25; }
.tile span { font-size: 0.85em; opacity: 0.86; }
.tile:first-child { grid-row: span 2; background: var(--field); color: var(--field-ink); }
.tile:first-child b { font-size: 2.1em; line-height: 1.2; }
.tile:nth-child(3), .tile:nth-child(4) { background: var(--tile-b); color: var(--tile-b-ink); }
.tiles .grid:has(> .tile:nth-child(2):last-child) { grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr; }
.tiles .grid:has(> .tile:nth-child(2):last-child) .tile:first-child { grid-row: span 1; }

/* ── 12. 마무리 closing ─────────────────────────── */
section.closing { justify-content: center; padding: 80px 110px; }
.closing h2 { font-size: 3.6em; line-height: 1.12; max-width: 1050px; }
.closing .lede { margin-top: 26px; }
.closing .meta { display: flex; gap: 56px; margin-top: 54px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 2px solid var(--rule-strong); }

/* 색 면 장 — 결이 정한 「면」 바탕으로 뒤집는다. 결마다 기본으로 면인 배치가 있고, 모델은 .alt 로 바꿀 수 있다 */
section.field { background: var(--field); color: var(--field-ink); --title: var(--field-ink); --accent-text: var(--field-accent); --accent: var(--field-accent); --ink-soft: var(--field-soft);
  --ink-faint: var(--field-faint); --rule: var(--field-rule); --rule-strong: var(--field-ink); --surface: var(--field-surface); --track: var(--field-track);
  --bar: var(--field-bar); --folio: var(--field-faint); }
section.field .kicker { color: var(--field-kicker); }

/* 칸 수에 맞춘 짜임 — 셋이면 한 줄, 넷이면 넷째 칸이 아래를 가로로 채운다(빈 칸이 남지 않게) */
.tiles .grid:has(> .tile:nth-child(3):last-child) { grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr; }
.tiles .grid:has(> .tile:nth-child(3):last-child) .tile:first-child { grid-row: span 1; }
.tiles .grid:has(> .tile:nth-child(4):last-child) .tile:nth-child(4) { grid-column: span 2; }
.stats .row:has(> .stat:nth-child(4)) .stat .v { font-size: 4.6em; }
.stats .row:has(> .stat:nth-child(4)) .stat { padding-right: 18px; margin-right: 18px; }

/* 흰 종이 · 파랑 — 업무 보고 기본(회의 · 계획 · 회사 소개). 참고: blue-professional(MIT · Zara Zhang) */
:root {
  --paper: #fbfaf7; --ink: #171a21; --ink-soft: #454b57; --ink-faint: #858a95; --title: #171a21;
  --accent: #1f4fd1; --accent-text: #1f4fd1; --rule: #dfe1e6; --rule-strong: #171a21;
  --surface: #eef0f4; --track: #e9ebf0; --bar: #b9c3da; --tile-b: #e3eafb; --tile-b-ink: #17306b;
  --field: #17306b; --field-ink: #ffffff; --field-accent: #9fc0ff; --field-soft: #d3dcf2; --field-faint: #93a3cc;
  --field-rule: #2c4687; --field-surface: #22407f; --field-track: #24427f; --field-bar: #5a74b0; --field-kicker: #9fc0ff;
  --sans: 'Pretendard', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; --display: 'Pretendard', 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; --display-weight: 700;
  --quote: 'Pretendard', 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; --quote-weight: 700; --figure: 'Pretendard', 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; --figure-weight: 700;
}
section.cover:not(.field)::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 46%; height: 100%; background: #eef2fb; clip-path: polygon(30% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
section.cover.field::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 46%; height: 100%; background: #1d3a80; clip-path: polygon(30% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
section.cover > * { position: relative; }
.compare .col, .tile { border-radius: 4px; }
</style><style data-sonjari-parts>:root{--pz-bg:var(--paper);--pz-ink:var(--ink);--pz-sub:var(--ink-soft);--pz-faint:var(--ink-faint);--pz-line:var(--rule);--pz-fill:var(--surface);--pz-accent:var(--field);--pz-on-accent:var(--field-ink);--pz-on-accent-sub:var(--field-soft);--pz-hi:#ffee9a;--pz-loss:#c33b2c;--pz-bar:var(--bar);--pz-font:var(--sans);--pz-num-font:var(--display);--pz-head-weight:var(--display-weight);--pz-num-weight:400;--pz-radius:0px;--pz-stroke:1px;--pz-card-border:0 solid transparent;--pz-card-shadow:none;--pz-shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.15);--pz-tape:rgba(255,255,255,.6);--pz-line-strong:var(--rule-strong);--pz-fill-2:var(--tile-b);--pz-fill-2-ink:var(--tile-b-ink);--pz-card:var(--surface);--pz-card-ink:var(--ink);--pz-key:var(--accent-text);--pz-head-color:var(--title);--pz-head-font:var(--display);--pz-card-key:var(--accent-text);--pz-label-font:var(--sans);--pz-c1:var(--surface);--pz-c1-ink:var(--ink);}
/* 표지 · 마무리 부품 (2026-10-26 대표 「템플릿은 참고만 — 글자 · 간격 · 줄 · 도형까지 손자리가 짓는다」).
   템플릿 표지를 통째로 베끼지 않는다. 글(머리 말 · 큰 제목 · 부제 · 이름:값 · 날짜/출처 · 쪽)은 **위에서 아래로 흐르는 한 줄기**에만 놓는다 —
   절대 위치 글이 없으니 글끼리 겹칠 수 없다(10-26 c81a10dd 표지: 긴 꼬리말이 작은 바닥 글과 겹쳤다).
   장식(.pz-deco)은 코드가 결 값으로 그리는 도형이고, 글 줄기가 비켜 가는 자리(padding)에만 놓인다.
   값은 slide_frames.frame_css 가 --pz-* 로 끼운다. 이 파일은 혼자 선다(IR 처럼 부품 묶음 CSS 가 없는 결도 쓴다). */
section.slide.pz-frame {
  width: 1280px; height: 720px; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; inset: auto; overflow: hidden; margin: 0;
  opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: none; pointer-events: auto; isolation: isolate;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; justify-content: flex-start;
  padding: 56px 72px 40px; background: var(--fr-bg); color: var(--fr-ink); font-family: var(--pz-font);
  text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -0.2px; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: break-word;
